CV pages were loaded with WebFetch (curl gets a Cloudflare 403). Raw SI: `forum-raw/t1938_pg1.html`, `t1938.c.txt`.

## Conditions
- **A (SI):** Onslaught-era Malgus vs end-of-KOTOR Revan. Rounds: sabers, Force, all-out, H2H.
- **B (CV, OP Sy8000):** Revan Reborn vs Malgus at *False Emperor* power level. In character, random encounter, 50 ft apart.
- **C (CV):** R1 Force, R2 sabers, R3 all-out. Versions are loosely defined. It is an old thread, with a lot of low-effort posts by aaronx20 and aaron15.

## Arguments for REVAN
- **Gauntlet and Star Forge.** Praxis (SI): Revan ran the Star Forge gauntlet and beat SF Malak. Malgus's best win is Ven Zallow.
- **Malgus's weak results.** Praxis (SI): Malgus "couldn't dispatch Arn" and praised the Outlander.
- **Revan Reborn's SOR feat.** ShootingNova (CV B): "Revan had this new feat of sending all these player characters and NPCs flying, including Satele Shan." Also: "Revan has a counter for pretty much anything Malgus has."
- **Nyriss.** Fallen548 (CV C): a drugged Revan reflected Nyriss's lightning and turned her to ash.
- **Range.** sXe619 (CV B): "Revan wins, especially because of the starting distance."
- **Skill.** Old CV C opening post: Revan "was known for his sense of precognition in battles". Malgus's "all-out, all-or-nothing form" is exploitable.

## Arguments for MALGUS
- **Saber pedigree.** steelhound56 (CV C): he killed the Temple swordmaster (Zallow), and Satele was twice at his mercy.
- **Raw output.**
  - ShootingNova (CV C, arguing Malgus's case for the saber and all-out rounds): Malgus's Force scream broke pillars, and he shrugged off Adraas's lightning.
  - Andy Steven Summers (CV C) posts a long block of Deceived quotes: the Zallow fight, the column shattering, the Aryn fight, the Adraas lightning.
  - BreakofDawn (SI): Malgus broke the Outlander's passive barrier and pulled down machinery while injured.
- **Revan's feats are deflated.** ShootingNova (CV C): Revan's best saber feat was beating a lone Imperial Guard. His telepathy against Vitiate needed Meetra's help: "As the Emperor fed off him, Meetra allowed Revan to feed off her..." He rates Revan 3-4 on a Yoda = 10 scale.
- **Onslaught dialogue.** Master Azronger (SI): "None of you have the resolve--the strength to beat me!" He pegs Malgus around Arcann.
- **Scaling chain.** HeartoftheForce (SI): see below. BreakofDawn calls it trolling.

## Counterarguments and the rebuttals that seemed to land
- Revan sent Satele flying (CV B) → highaccuser: the Jedi all get back up. ShootingNova: it still shows his claimed power ("Since Revan has always been stated in accolades as a super Bad@ss…"). **Landed.** Nobody pursued it further.
- Revan reflected Nyriss's lightning (CV C) → the_last_kryptonian: that was Tutaminis skill, not raw power. **Partly landed.** It shifted the claim from "power" to "versatility".
- Malgus is only "Zallow-level" → steelhound56/BreakofDawn: the swordmaster kill plus the protagonist parity in SWTOR. Not answered on SI.
- Revan beat an army → old CV C replies: mooks are mooks. Unresolved.

## Verdict tally (POSTER OPINION)
- **A, SI t1938 (all rounds, mostly not split):** Revan 5 (DC77, IG, Nute_Chethray, EmperorCaedus, lorenzo.r.2nd). Malgus 2 (BreakofDawn, AncientPower). Azronger implied Malgus ~ Arcann without a clear vote.
- **B, CV 1633494:** Revan in nearly every post (ShootingNova, sXe619, highaccuser, and others). One "Revan, I suppose" ("just a hair" ahead). No Malgus votes recorded.
- **C, CV 660149, by round:**
  - R1 Force: Revan (clear majority)
  - R2 sabers: Malgus (majority, e.g. ShootingNova, steelhound56, and the "70/30 Malgus" post)
  - R3 all-out: Revan (majority, with some "could go either way" and a post-Revan-novel "Malgus takes the lightsaber round, and the all out round")
  - Most common line: **Revan / Malgus / Revan.**

## Scaling chains used
- HeartoftheForce (SI): Malgus ≥ post-KotET Outlander >>> "SO KOTFE Outlander" (abbreviation as posted) > Revan. BreakofDawn dismissed it as trolling.
- Revan > SF Malak (gauntlet) vs Malgus > Zallow (Temple). Praxis.
- Revan "3-4" vs Yoda "10" (ShootingNova, CV C, an impressionistic scale).

## Conflicts with our notes
- **Supported:**
  - The column shatter: `deceived-novel-feats.md` #27 "Power went with it, shattering a nearby column…".
  - The Zallow fight and the Adraas material (`malgus-legends-quotes.txt`, `malgus-respect-1557966.txt`).
  - The Nyriss reflection (`revan-legends-quotes.txt`).
- **Overstated:** "Satele twice at his mercy" (steelhound56). Our `malgus-legends-quotes.txt` says Malgus "easily overpowered" *Padawan* Satele "at first, but a toss of Darach's lightsaber put Malgus on the defensive". The second encounter is the Alderaan duel. The "twice at his mercy" wording isn't in our notes as such.
- **Unverified locally:**
  - "Malgus couldn't dispatch Arn" (Praxis)
  - the Revan/Meetra "feed off her" quote (not in our grep)
  - the Revan "Imperial Guard" saber feat
- Tutaminis vs raw power on the Nyriss feat: our note phrases it as "absorbed... and channeled it through his own body" (absorption/redirect), which is consistent with the_last_kryptonian's framing.

## Original-work check (added 2026-10-11)
Each quote, scan or feat cited above, with its original work. "Named in thread" means a poster gave the work. "From our notes" means the same quote is in one of our files, with the source shown there. "NOT IDENTIFIED" means neither the thread nor our notes give the work. Those are left unsourced, not guessed. Poster verdicts and opinions are not listed.
- Revan sending player characters and NPCs (incl. Satele) flying → *SWTOR: Shadow of Revan* ("SOR", named by ShootingNova). The mission/scene is NOT IDENTIFIED.
- Revan reflecting Nyriss's lightning → *The Old Republic: Revan*, from our notes (`revan-legends-quotes.txt`, Wookieepedia "Revan/Legends" ref 9).
- The column shatter → *Deceived*, Ch2, L883 (`deceived-novel-feats.md` #27). The Zallow fight is Ch2, L873-921. The Aryn fight and the Adraas lightning are *Deceived* (see `deceived-novel-feats.md` / `malgus-respect-1557966.txt`, "Source: Deceived").
- Malgus breaking the Outlander's barrier / pulling down machinery → *SWTOR*. No expansion is named. NOT IDENTIFIED.
- "None of you have the resolve--the strength to beat me!" → *Star Wars: The Old Republic – Onslaught*, named in thread (`forum-raw/t1938.txt` L163-166).
- "As the Emperor fed off him, Meetra allowed Revan to feed off her..." → *The Old Republic: Revan*. CORRECTION to "not in our grep" above: the line IS in `vitiate-comicvine-respect-part1.txt` L1280 ("Source named in post: Star Wars: The Old Republic: Revan").
- Revan beating a lone Imperial Guard; "Malgus couldn't dispatch Arn" → no work named. NOT IDENTIFIED.
- Padawan Satele overpowered by Malgus → "Return" (The Old Republic official website), from our notes (`malgus-legends-quotes.txt`, Wookieepedia "Darth Malgus" ref 11).
- Revan running the Star Forge gauntlet and beating SF Malak → *Knights of the Old Republic*.
